headline: Six Sectors Intensify as Frontlines Shift
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the map shows a reshuffling of the most volatile theatres. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest sector, logging thirty‑nine ownership changes in the past day; its two‑hour tempo has fallen to two flips from a prior ten, while six flips occurred in the last six hours. Weathered Expanse has awakened, recording six flips in the latest six‑hour window and twenty‑three overall, a sharp rise from its earlier lull. Deadlands now reports nine flips in six hours and eighteen daily, up from two and eleven previously. Godcrofts, quiet in the last two hours, still shows four flips in the past six hours and nine in the day. Stonecradle has added four flips in the last two hours and eleven in six, totalling eighteen for the day. Fishermans Row and Callahans Passage each retain a half‑dozen daily turnovers but show no fresh two‑hour activity. Casualty streams are climbing on Stlican, Callahans, Weathered, Linn Mercy and Terminus, while enlistments surge at Callahans (56 per hour) and Kings Cage (10 per hour) but dip on Weathered (31 per hour) and Stlican (26 per hour). The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held southern fringe remain static with no base turnovers.
